Gomoku fixture fonts
====================

Instrument Serif (Regular)
Instrument Sans (Regular)
Geist Mono (Regular)

All three font families are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
The license texts are copied next to the font files:

- assets/fonts/InstrumentSerif-OFL.txt
- assets/fonts/InstrumentSans-OFL.txt
- assets/fonts/GeistMono-OFL.txt

Source: the canvas-fonts collection bundled with the canvas-design skill.
These files are used only by the test fixture; they are not part of the
model-facing Godot tools.
